## 4a. ESM (frozen) at every commit: with vs without per-state memoisation

changed-state reads = reads whose evidence state differs from the current anchor's (action ≠ same); fresh judgements = distinct (anchor, state) pairs actually judged; memo hits = changed-state reads served from the memo. Tokens = judge + re-derivation tokens per fact. Without memo, every changed-state read is judged again.
